errors.text_span: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die Anzahl der Personen in verschiedenen Einkommensklassen dar, die durch das Faktorverfahren belastet wurden.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly implies the chart only shows one series of data ('belastet' - burdened). The chart is a grouped bar chart showing two series: 'Entlastete' (relieved) and 'Belastete' (burdened).

errors.text_span: und die Spanne reicht von 0 bis 200, wobei die Werte in 100er-Schritten beschriftet sind.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not represent a continuous span from 0 to 200, nor are its values labeled in 100-unit steps. It consists of discrete income brackets, such as '0 - < 20', '20 - < 40', etc.

errors.text_span: Der längste Balken, der für den Bereich 40 - < 80 Darstellung von 380 Personen erfasst,
errors.evidence: The longest bar is not 380. The actual longest bar has a value of 1,240 and belongs to the '20 - < 40' income bracket for the 'Entlastete' series. The description also combines two categories ('40 - < 60' and '60 - < 80') into a non-existent one ('40 - < 80').

errors.text_span: wobei der kürzeste Balken für den Bereich 0 - < 20 Darstellung von 10 Personen erfasst.
errors.evidence: The shortest bar is not 10. The actual shortest bar has a value of 2 and corresponds to the 'Entlastete' series in the '≥ 200' income bracket.

errors.text_span: Es gibt einen einzelnen Balken, der die Gesamtzahl der belasteten Personen in 1.240 darstellt,
errors.evidence: This is completely incorrect. The bar with a value of 1,240 represents the number of 'Entlastete' (relieved) people in the '20 - < 40' income bracket, not the total number of 'belasteten' (burdened) people.
The income bracket on the chart is '100 - < 200', not '100 - < 1000'.
The description invents an income category '40 - < 80' which does not exist on the chart. The chart has separate categories for '40 - < 60' and '60 - < 80'.

errors.text_span: Es gibt einen einzelnen Balken, der die Gesamtzahl der belasteten Personen in 1.240 darstellt, mit Balken, die die Anzahl der Personen für verschiedene Einkommensschwellenwerte anzeigen, darunter 0 - < 20, 20 - < 40, 40 - < 60, 60 - < 80, 80 - < 100, 100 - < 1000 und > 200.
errors.evidence: This long and convoluted sentence is grammatically awkward and contains multiple factual errors, making it nearly impossible to understand and highly misleading.
